findings.summary: At immutable revision 437835ded412544fd294c2b910942208216e85b2, crucible-harness materially differs from prior audited autonomous-scientist candidates by committing a provenance-run/certificate layer in the same complete tree as benchmark contracts, initial manifests and inputs: provenance-runs/pilot-20260809-real-20 contains per-arm gate/metrics JSON, while provenance-certificates, trusted oracles and exp_code.certificate.json are also committed.

The tree-level package is promising but not yet a Phase-1 accepted replay route: exact run-to-input/config hashes, ordered realized output rows, evaluator decision semantics, result/paper identity binding and zero-executor static replay require content-level verification. A literal indexed search for transcript returned no results, but that non-return is not absence evidence.

residual_child_problems: ordered realized execution/output transcript or equivalent auditable event sequence
gate/verdict decision semantics and oracle binding
proof that useful replay can remain static with no hidden executor or optional paid/quota dependency

exact_next_action: Open exactly one committed realized-run chain from arghavan-b/crucible-harness revision 437835ded412544fd294c2b910942208216e85b2, preferably one pilot_seeded_comparison I/V pair together with its contract, initial_manifest and corresponding certificate, and test whether file contents bind exact input/config hashes to realized ordered outputs to gate/verdict decision to comparison/paper claim while remaining statically inspectable at zero incremental cost and without optional quota or hidden execution. Do not broaden to another candidate until this content-level chain is resolved.
